input.summary: Fix illusory cap basis in 21.1: greater of 12 months' amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and all Order Forms, or USD 1,000,000
input.comment: [Playbook] The cap currently keys off "Fees", which is defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the mutual cap is effectively USD 12,000 and far below our floor. We have changed the basis to the greater of all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and all Order Forms in the preceding twelve months and USD 1,000,000; Excluded Claims (indemnities, confidentiality, data protection and security, wilful misconduct) remain outside the cap. If USD 1,000,000 is an issue, we can fall back to a straight twelve months' fees cap across all Order Forms.

ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000.
